title: zesty velvety hangover-cure german potatoes tagine
description: a flavorful german-inspired tagine packed with potatoes, frozen mixed berries, and a hint of floral notes to aid in hangover recovery.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a deep frying pan over medium-high heat.
Using a thermometer, maintain a temperature of 350°F (175°C).
Slice the potatoes into 1/2-inch thick rounds and carefully add them to the hot oil in batches, if necessary.
Deep-fry the potatoes until they are golden brown and crispy, approximately 4-5 minutes per batch.
Remove the fried potatoes from the oil with a slotted spoon and place them on paper towels to drain excess oil.
In a large ceramic tagine, sauté the chopped onion and minced garlic over medium heat until softened.
Add the thawed frozen mixed berries, honey, Dijon mustard, and chopped fresh parsley to the tagine.
Stir well to combine and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until the mixture has slightly thickened.
Add the fried potatoes to the tagine and sprinkle with kosher salt to taste.
Serve the zesty velvety hangover-cure german potatoes tagine immediately and enjoy!
